description:
Beom-Yeol has spent every Christmas alone, a shy virgin whose only thrill is secretly admiring Jun Sang, the tough gangster who protects his little shop. And this year is no different...or so he thinks. While indulging in a slightly too vivid fantasy about Jun Sang, Beom-Yeol suddenly comes face to face with a strange creature he has never seen before. The being introduces himself as Ddobomi No. 8291, also known as ""the God of Lust"", and claims he has come to help Beom-Yeol with his tragic lack of a love life. His gift? A pair of Bluetooth underwear that links Beom-Yeol’s senses directly to the most intimate parts of whoever he touches. With this outrageous invention and a long standing crush inches away, Beom-Yeol might finally escape his lonely Christmas curse. 

The real question is… will he survive the experience?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*
